writer: Claude Agent SDK subagent, Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5)

map.name: Brackenford
map.trouble: Red Corwin's bandits hold the old watchtower on Crow Hill and rob the north road, so the way north is shut.

bounty_offer.specifics: Ulric, an old shepherd at the edge of the Ashwood, pays to have the wolves that take his sheep killed.

offer.speaker: Ulric
offer.text: Honestly, my flock has shrunk quite a lot, with wolves prowling out of the Ashwood. I'll pay good gold to whoever thins that pack.

reminder.speaker: Ulric
reminder.text: Hunter! Go out after that wolf pack!

completion.speaker: Ulric
completion.text: Fine work, young sir! This gold will surely help me rebuild the flock those wolves scattered across my pasture. It seems no beast in the Ashwood can stand against you!

heirloom_fetch.specifics: Wenna, the miller's widow: the Urchins of the old barrow stole the crank of her waterwheel.

offer.speaker: Wenna
offer.text:
Blast! Where were you, lad!? The Urchins broke into my mill last night and they'd have carried off every sack of flour if the ferrymen had not come running with their poles just in time!

But in the uproar, the thieves grabbed my waterwheel's crank, making the flour my smallest worry! No grain gets ground in Brackenford without it!

Follow them east of the ford, to the old barrow! Will you bring my crank home, or is the mill finished?

refusal.speaker: Wenna
refusal.text: Return when you've changed your mind.

reminder.speaker: Wenna
reminder.text: Nothing yet? Well, keep searching in that barrow by the ford. My crank must be found at once!

completion.speaker: Wenna
completion.text: I trust you gave those Urchins a thrashing they'll long remember! I'm not sure what this old ankh is worth, but it's yours.

after.speaker: Wenna
after.text: Bless you for helping a poor lonely widow.

journal.text: Recover the waterwheel crank from the barrow for Wenna the widow.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover the waterwheel crank from the barrow for Wenna the widow.

two_givers.specifics: Halvard wants the tithe chest Corwin's bandits took back from Crow Hill; Sly Wat says a beast is drinking the Drowned Lantern's ale.

offer_a.speaker: Halvard
offer_a.text:
Ohhhh, how could this happen? Corwin's bandits beat both of my gate guards and took the tithe chest. There is no one left to send.

Hurry, you must catch them before it reaches Crow Hill.

offer_b.speaker: Wat
offer_b.text: I have heard some beast down in the Drowned Lantern cellar drinks the ale dry.

outcome_a.speaker: Halvard
outcome_a.text:
The tithe chest! Bless you, young sir! Brackenford owes you a great debt for such a bold deed.

This sword is yours, a modest gift from all of us. The north gate is open to you now. Get whatever supplies are needed, then hurry on toward Crow Hill.

outcome_b.speaker: Wat
outcome_b.text: Bless you! You saved the ale! Now, go and see the barkeep. I bet he'll pour you a free mug for your trouble.

journal_a.text: Go up Crow Hill and take back Halvard's tithe chest.

journal_b.text: Something is drinking the Drowned Lantern's ale -- find and kill it!

rescue.specifics: Brother Anselm's novice Pip chased the Urchins into the old barrow and has not come back.

plea.speaker: Anselm
plea.text:
Praise be! No novice in all Brackenford is braver than my Pip. But the boy went after the Urchins into the old barrow east of the ford. Not a sign of him since, and the pests bite all who come near.

Bring him home safe, and a reward awaits you here.

Take this potion along, in case things go badly below.

reminder.speaker: Anselm
reminder.text: I have no more potions to spare just now. Good fortune down in that barrow. Those Urchins can be a nasty, biting bunch.

found.speaker: Pip
found.text: Filthy Urchins have taken over this barrow, chasing me into every corner. You must lead me out, stay close and fend off these wretched beasts.

completion.speaker: Anselm
completion.text: Bless you, my son. You did a holy deed, and this chapel won't forget it.

journal.text: Lead the lost novice from the barrow to safety.

main_opening.specifics: A townsman points to Halvard in the Moot Hall, who sends the player against Red Corwin on Crow Hill.

herald.speaker: Townsman
herald.text: Eek! I saw Halvard storm right into the Moot Hall in a fury!

opening.speaker: Halvard
opening.text:
Stranger! Thank goodness, help us! Rotten bandits have seized the watchtower on Crow Hill, north of town, and no traveler on the road gets by them with his purse! Red Corwin leads that whole wicked rabble!

Drive him off, and a fine reward is yours!

reminder.speaker: Halvard
reminder.text: The bandits still hold Crow Hill!

journal.text: Drive Red Corwin off Crow Hill.
